decision: How ready is this page to rank in search, be cited by AI engines and win direct answers, and what should we fix first?
limitations: It only scores the pass, partial or fail results it is given. It does not fetch or inspect the page, so the score is as good as the audit against the rubric.
Omitted or misspelled check names count as fail with no warning, and unrecognised JSON returns 0/100, grade F, rather than an error. Check every check name was read.
It measures readiness, not traffic or citations. The GEO checks score whether claims are checkable and do not predict a lift.
FAQPage schema and llms.txt still earn points though the skill calls them hygiene, not Google levers, so the score can rise with no change in search visibility.
review: Whoever owns the site confirms the rendering check used the crawler's view of the page (for example curl -A GPTBot) and spot-checks the failing items before fixes are prioritised. Pair the score with analytics for outcomes.
